_meta.question: Quantos processos foram abertos, quantos concluiram no ano e quantas atividades geraram?
_meta.nondeterminism: consulta o Trino ao vivo; o lakehouse esta sob curadoria ativa

caveat: n_generated counts protocols whose 'Processo gerado' event was executed by a SEAD-PI/... unidade inside the year -- the born-in-orgao definition the article uses. It is not the SEI autuacao field. n_conclusion_event_logged_same_year applies the descricao_replace predicate above and is NOT the article's concluded population. n_corpus_protocolos is PINNED to the corpus the graph actually loaded when corpus_source == 'graph'; n_corpus_in_gold_now re-derives it from the live gold table and will drift, because a case concluded in 2025 can receive a new andamento later and then fail dt_ultimo_andamento < next-year. Report the pinned number: it is what every downstream figure was computed on. The article's corpus is graph-derived: the situacao stage calls a case concluded when it has no EM_ABERTO_NA_UNIDADE edge left at year end. The text predicate used here answers a different question -- 'did a conclusion event get logged' -- and returns a larger number. Report them as two measures, never as one. Neither figure is reconcilable with artifacts/traces, which hold a different slice. n_documents_all_activity counts distinct document numbers over every activity of those cases; n_documents_activity_within_year restricts the activity side to the year, which is the scope the graph load used. The manuscripts' 148,178 is a Neo4j :Documento node count taken from a graph state and a lakehouse snapshot that no longer exist; it sits between these two and reproduces as neither. n_opening_documents_parsed counts parsed_documents/ on disk, the artifact the 12,259 figure refers to. Two counts the article reports and this stage still does NOT produce -- processos concluded without an embedded opening document, and opening documents cancelled at source -- live in the document pipeline, not in sei_atividades.
